title: Control Resonant
provenance: Reported by DaceJoy02 (highball#531, 2026-10-27), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22: on Wine 11 r26 (D3DMetal 4 beta 3) it freezes seconds after boot on the Remedy logo, rarely boots with heavy stutter and random freezes, and starts only with DLSS off. On Wine 10 r29 (D3DMetal 4 beta 2) it crashes at once with 'Game has encountered a serious problem'. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: DirectX 12 only. Not running reliably yet. Both engines tried carry Apple's D3DMetal 4 betas, and D3DMetal 3 on the Wine 11 engine r27 is untested.

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes on the Remedy logo seconds after boot on D3DMetal 4 beta 3, starts only with DLSS off, and crashes at once on the Wine 10 engine r29
knownIssues.fix: none known. Untested: Wine 11 r27 (D3DMetal 3) with DLSS off
